body: TRPG action: I am the outside auditor. I will open the register at the seven complaints and compare each entry against the dispatch ledger. I am checking four fields by hand: sender, intended recipient, time the line marked sent, and whether the page records a delivery receipt rather than merely a queue handoff. That distinction is what my report must not erase. Roll: d20 = 1. Specificity bonus expected +3; total 4 versus DC 11, failure. In the rain-damp book, I find the seven names, but the ink has run together precisely where each recipient and receipt should be. I copy the visible timestamps too quickly; the paper tears along the binding and scatters the only legible fragments across the floor. I cannot honestly claim the messages were delivered, and now I cannot reconstruct which seven records prove the gap. I look at the technician and say: The green board may be true about sending. It is not evidence of arrival.
